purpose: Audit-only artifact discriminators for eliminator-first representation and algebra-derived design; not a new routing policy or executable test runner.
evaluation: Present scenarios and required behavior to the agent; reserve expected artifacts, falsifiers, and evidence criteria for evaluation. Accept any admissible implementation satisfying the same requirements.

artifact_cases.scenario: An activated representation decision concerns a pure constructor-generated finite-list producer immediately followed by a right fold. No consumer inspects, retains, shares, serializes, or authorizes the intermediate list. Its allocation is the witnessed cost.
required_behavior: Preserve empty, singleton, and longer outputs, including nonassociative fold algebras and fixed right-fold nesting.
Preserve all required final outputs; eliminate only the unneeded intermediate representation.
expected_artifact: A native fused loop or local producer/algebra lowering is admissible; a public Church datatype is not required.
Name the pure, total, finite, parametric assumptions and the fold/build preservation argument.
artifact_cases.falsifier: A left-fold reassociation changes subtraction results, or the implementation merely renames the allocated intermediate while claiming fusion.
artifact_cases.required_valid_counterpart: A constructor-generated producer preserves its list under constructor interpretation and preserves the final right-fold result under direct interpretation.
evidence_required: Representation round trips and algebra-morphism preservation at an explicit evidence strength.
Eliminated nodes in the actual lowering or a declared finite cost model; whole-host-workload measurements before claiming performance.

artifact_cases.scenario: A proposal replaces an adequate finite Expr datatype and its fold solely because it has numeric and rendering interpreters. The native API meets every current requirement and no representation cost or missing capability is evidenced.
required_behavior: Keep numeric evaluation, rendering, and existing callers correct.
expected_artifact: Preserve the native datatype/fold against this live proposal, or justify a genuinely material alternative rather than treating interpreter multiplicity as sufficient.
artifact_cases.falsifier: Introduce a higher-rank callback framework or select a universal route merely because there are two interpreters.
artifact_cases.required_valid_counterpart: The native fold already evaluates Add(Literal(1),Literal(2)) to 3 and renders (1+2).
evidence_required: The same observations under both candidates and an explicit dividend, or its evidenced absence.

artifact_cases.scenario: An operation plan must be inspected and authorized, stored in a versioned format, and replayed after restart. A proposed callback replacement captures mutable state that can change the plan after approval.
required_behavior: Execute only the exact approved plan under its authorized context.
Retain required serialization, restart replay, inspection, and migration capabilities.
expected_artifact: Retain explicit versioned plan data at those boundaries. A private specialized executor is admissible only with a preservation and exact-plan binding argument.
artifact_cases.falsifier: Approve a plan containing operation A, mutate the capture to operation B, then execute B; or make restart replay depend on an unavailable closure.
artifact_cases.required_valid_counterpart: An approved unchanged plan survives serialization/restart and executes its permitted operation; rejecting all execution is not a repair.
evidence_required: Approved-subject/executed-subject agreement, context validity, and round trips through the required wire/storage representation.

artifact_cases.scenario: A native persistent list exposes repeated head/tail inspection and shared-tail identity. Replacing it with a fold-only representation is proposed based on cheap construction.
required_behavior: Preserve head/tail behavior, the required shared-tail identity, and the established whole-workload resource bound.
expected_artifact: Keep the native representation unless a proposed alternative proves those capabilities and costs. Compare Scott-style one-layer elimination only when useful; do not assume an encoding name supplies the cost law.
artifact_cases.falsifier: Repeatedly reconstruct or traverse the suffix, lose shared identity, or report only constructor cost while ignoring destruction and reification.
artifact_cases.required_valid_counterpart: Two native references to the same tail still observe the same required identity and can inspect it without rebuilding.
evidence_required: Construction plus repeated consumption/destruction, reification, stack, and allocation evidence in the actual host.
Acknowledge expressibility versus efficiency: folds can encode deconstruction, but that does not establish the required resource bound.

artifact_cases.scenario: An unrestricted CExpr = forall R. Algebra<R> -> R is proposed as a way to hide literal values because its tree constructors are private.
required_behavior: Do not grant a confidentiality or authorization guarantee that the public elimination surface defeats.
expected_artifact: Apply the constructor algebra to reconstruct the expression and reject the secrecy claim. Any restricted-observation replacement needs its own authority owner and revised representation claim.
artifact_cases.falsifier: Treat private representation as secret data while decode(c) reconstructs Add(Literal(1),Literal(2)).
artifact_cases.required_valid_counterpart: Public numeric and rendering interpretations still work when they are permitted; unrestricted reconstruction is not a bug in a representation with no secrecy requirement.
evidence_required: An executable reconstructing interpretation and an explicit distinction between representation abstraction and access control.

artifact_cases.scenario: An eager host admits g(k,z) that calls k(99,z), discards that result, and returns k(1,z). The consumer logs its input and sums, or throws when its input is 99.
required_behavior: Preserve returned values, effect traces, and exception timing, not only numeric results.
expected_artifact: Reject unqualified fold/build fusion for these admitted callbacks/algebras, or supply a separate effect-aware law that actually covers them.
artifact_cases.falsifier: foldr(k,0,build(g)) returns 1 with trace [1], but g(k,0) returns 1 with trace [99,1]; only the latter throws at 99.
artifact_cases.required_valid_counterpart: The pure constructor-generated singleton producer still satisfies the finite pure law; do not reject all fusion.
evidence_required: Both traces and outcomes, explicit eager evaluation, and the missing purity/admission hypothesis.

artifact_cases.scenario: A delayed builder captures a mutable list initially [1]. The incumbent materializes a stable value before that list becomes [1,2]; a proposed replacement interprets the capture later.
required_behavior: Preserve the promised snapshot across mutation and repeated observations.
Preserve the actual lifetime and consumption policy for any one-shot resource.
expected_artifact: Snapshot the required data, enforce immutable ownership, or retain the native value. Do not call an unrestricted closure a parametric immutable value.
artifact_cases.falsifier: The stored value observes [1] while delayed interpretation sees [1,2], or a second interpretation silently reconsumes a one-shot source.
artifact_cases.required_valid_counterpart: An immutable snapshot continues to yield [1] through both constructor and length interpretations after external mutation.
evidence_required: Mutation/repeated-consumption observations and ownership or protocol evidence, not only a constructor-time check.

artifact_cases.scenario: A host interface has the schematic shape forall R. (F R -> R) -> R and some passing samples, but arbitrary callbacks, casts, effects, or divergence remain admitted. A proposal claims initiality and dependent induction from that shape.
required_behavior: Match claims to the actual model and admission surface without obstructing a useful ordinary implementation.
expected_artifact: Keep a lawful structure or explicit weaker claim when justified. For initiality, state the functor/model, constructors, admissible algebra maps, parametricity/equivalence assumptions, factorization, and uniqueness argument.
Do not infer dependent induction, totality, or a performance improvement from fold computation rules or sampled round trips.
artifact_cases.falsifier: Promote a polymorphic-looking API or finite example equality into a universal property while omitting admitted hostile callbacks.
artifact_cases.required_valid_counterpart: Pure constructor-generated finite expressions can be evaluated and reconstructed under their stated assumptions without requiring an initiality claim to use them.
evidence_required: Separate computation, two representation round trips, algebra-morphism preservation, universal uniqueness, and induction claims.
Classify derivation, exhaustive finite evidence, sampled tests, and unrun formal/model evaluations honestly.

artifact_cases.scenario: A first-use reward-combination boundary must aggregate independently earned rewards. Accepted requirements make award order irrelevant but require every occurrence to count. The candidate public API exposes a list and callers repeatedly normalize it; a proposed set replacement removes duplicates.
required_behavior: Combining two independently earned copies of reward r records two occurrences, regardless of combination order or grouping.
Preserve source-required provenance, failure behavior, and effect order outside the count observation.
expected_artifact: Derive the carrier and combine operation from count observations and interacting equations. A native count map or any equivalent observation-preserving representation is admissible; no generic algebra framework is required.
Reject idempotence for this reward algebra. Compare complete caller contracts rather than treating an internally retained list as intrinsically wrong.
artifact_cases.falsifier: A set returns one occurrence for combine(singleton(r),singleton(r)), or apparent commutativity is obtained by erasing a required audit distinction or reordering effects.
artifact_cases.required_valid_counterpart: Empty combination is neutral; differently grouped and permuted combinations retain each reward's complete count.
evidence_required: Count-preservation, identity, associativity, and commutativity at an explicit evidence strength, with a duplicate-reward non-law witness.
The obligations removed from callers, the required distinctions retained, and a source-supported owner-local change.

artifact_cases.scenario: A superficially similar combination API records an ordered audit trace. Its accepted public contract distinguishes action A followed by B from B followed by A. A proposal replaces the trace with reward counts because counts combine commutatively.
required_behavior: Preserve the ordered audit trace and required failure or partial-effect observations.
Allow both valid action sequences when authorized; rejecting all combinations is not an adequate repair.
expected_artifact: Reject commutativity under this observation and preserve a trace-bearing native representation. A separately derived count projection may coexist without replacing the authoritative trace.
Let the required observation adjudicate the proposed law, rather than weaken the contract to obtain the algebra used in the reward-count case.
artifact_cases.falsifier: The proposed comparator identifies [A,B] with [B,A], or grants permission to reorder execution because a derived count projection agrees.
artifact_cases.required_valid_counterpart: Grouping an already ordered concatenation differently preserves its order; swapping A and B does not.
evidence_required: An asymmetric ordered witness and the accepted source that makes order observable.
Separate accounting observations, execution effects, and effect-safe retry claims.

artifact_cases.scenario: Separate production traversals interpret reward accumulation and completion for a finite challenge language with Done, Reward(r,next), and Gate(token,next). Accepted semantics emit immediately available rewards without requiring an event. A gate consumes one matching event; that event cannot satisfy another sequential gate.
required_behavior: Gate(x,Reward(r,Done)) emits r and completes on its first x, not on a later event.
Gate(x,Gate(x,Reward(r,Done))) requires two x events; preserve the residual behavior after the first.
Reward(r,Done) emits r without an event, and Done does not emit the reward again.
expected_artifact: Derive a native step returning emitted rewards and a sufficient residual challenge, then derive the production observations from that common semantics, or retain an existing equally adequate owner.
Do not consolidate an independent verification oracle onto the production step or require an additional interpreter framework.
artifact_cases.falsifier: Reward emission is delayed until a second event, one x passes both sequential gates, completed residuals emit again, or equal current status is used to erase different next-event behavior.
artifact_cases.required_valid_counterpart: A nonmatching event leaves the waiting gate unchanged; after one matching event the second gate still waits, and after the second it emits exactly once.
evidence_required: Immediate/no-input observations, matching and nonmatching traces, reward multiplicity, and residual-state continuation checks.
A general preservation argument or explicitly bounded differential evidence; production sharing does not establish oracle independence.

artifact_cases.scenario: A tile API has clockwise and counterclockwise rotation, with four-turn and inverse properties. Existing observations use only empty or symmetric rasters. Two alternative implementations make both rotations identity or exchange their directions. The accepted row-major contract maps clockwise([[1,2],[3,4]]) to [[3,1],[4,2]].
required_behavior: Preserve the stated clockwise direction, inverse direction, and dimension changes for non-square rasters.
Distinguish semantic equality from agreement under an uninformative observation.
expected_artifact: Expose that both wrong implementations satisfy the structural equations, then add the requirement-bound asymmetric observation that rejects them.
Keep valid rotations and existing useful properties; do not call the finite anchor a complete universal characterization.
artifact_cases.falsifier: An all-identity or direction-swapped implementation passes the claimed discriminator, or all-size equivalence is inferred from zero-sized rendering.
artifact_cases.required_valid_counterpart: Correct clockwise and counterclockwise rotations remain inverses and satisfy the asymmetric anchor; an empty raster can still be valid input.
evidence_required: Executed or explicitly proposed wrong-model controls, nonempty asymmetric observations, and dimensional checks under the host's actual representation.
Separate law conformance, law adequacy, finite model coverage, and a general theorem.

artifact_cases.scenario: A finite expression API admits Literal(nonnegative integer), Add, and Negate with mathematical-integer semantics. A generator still constructs only Literal and Add, and every sampled evaluation is nonnegative. A proposed optimization uses that mined regularity to reject negative results.
required_behavior: Evaluate Negate(Literal(1)) as -1 and preserve valid nested uses of all three public constructors.
Do not turn unexercised public operations into an implicit domain restriction.
expected_artifact: Reject the nonnegativity claim and inspect effective constructor and interaction coverage. Extend valid public generation to exercise Negate and its compositions, not merely list its name in unreachable generator code.
Keep malformed-ingress tests separate, and shrink a failing expression while preserving its valid-domain preconditions and relevant failure.
artifact_cases.falsifier: The suite declares the full algebra covered without ever evaluating Negate, promotes sampled nonnegativity into authority, or shrinks to an invalid fixture that fails before evaluation.
artifact_cases.required_valid_counterpart: Literal(1) and Add(Literal(1),Literal(2)) still evaluate correctly; Negate(Negate(Literal(1))) evaluates to 1.
evidence_required: Observed constructor/depth/interaction coverage for the executed population and a minimal valid negative-result witness.
Explicit sample/discard/timeout limits; unbounded-domain or resource claims cannot be inferred from the retained cases.

artifact_cases.scenario: The accepted reward contract requires two independently earned identical awards to count twice. The incumbent incorrectly stores rewards in a set, so equation discovery reports combine(x,x) = x. A refactor would replace the set with correct additive counts, but a newly generated regression property insists on idempotence.
required_behavior: Honor accepted duplicate-award semantics rather than preserve the incumbent's bug as a compatibility law.
Retain independently justified identity and associative-combination properties.
expected_artifact: Adjudicate the mined equation against source authority and an independent count observation; reject the false idempotence property and correct the production carrier or interpreter.
Justify the oracle change independently; changing a test does not retroactively make its failing execution a pass.
artifact_cases.falsifier: Preserve the set to satisfy the discovered law, silently weaken the required counts, or delete all regression properties instead of rejecting the unsupported one.
artifact_cases.required_valid_counterpart: A singleton award remains one occurrence and combining with empty changes nothing; the duplicate case yields two.
evidence_required: Distinguish accepted requirement, implementation regularity, candidate equation, and retained regression property.
Independent requirement-to-observation justification for both the production correction and the rejected equation.

artifact_cases.scenario: A finite pure expression language has Literal and left-to-right checked Add with bounded integer arithmetic. A transparent syntax interpreter is a candidate semantic model. A proposed compact instruction representation changes internal nodes and may reassociate additions. The accepted observation includes success value or overflow failure; optimization must retain the original evaluation order.
required_behavior: Preserve success versus overflow and the exact successful value under the declared bounds and left-to-right nesting.
Do not preserve incidental tree or instruction-list equality as part of the public contract.
expected_artifact: Establish the simple model's relation to the accepted semantics, then compare the lowered implementation through those observations and a translation or simulation argument.
Use an existing sufficient oracle or direct proof instead when adequate; no mandatory second implementation or public IR.
artifact_cases.falsifier: At bounds [-2,2], Add(Add(2,1),-1) fails but the reassociated Add(2,Add(1,-1)) succeeds; a value-only or unbounded-integer model hides the distinction.
artifact_cases.required_valid_counterpart: Add(Add(1,1),-1) succeeds with 1 under both correct representations, even though their internal data differs.
evidence_required: Failure-aware differential or derivational evidence bound to the admitted model and host arithmetic; explicitly label any finite domain.
Separate model validation, implementation conformance, and measured full-workload performance; shared production logic is not independent verification.

artifact_cases.scenario: A live proposal replaces an existing count-map owner and native fold with a generic algebra/interpreter framework. The incumbent already preserves required multiplicity, effects, and all sanctioned construction paths behind a complete caller contract. No missing capability, duplicated production semantics, material resource cost, or supported change burden is evidenced.
required_behavior: Retain the complete caller contract and required observations while resolving the explicit replacement proposal.
Keep ordinary implementation and mechanical documentation work nonactivating when the proposal is absent and no semantic invalidator appears.
expected_artifact: Preserve the adequate incumbent against this live proposal; an already-dispositive comparison needs no ADD worksheet, second model, new observation layer, or categorical framework.
Distinguish that preservation decision from routine nonactivation, which produces no disposition or receipt.
artifact_cases.falsifier: Treat reading the book or naming an algebra as a dividend, manufacture another challenger, or create a preservation receipt for routine work with no live semantic pressure.
artifact_cases.required_valid_counterpart: The same native count operations preserve duplicate awards and expose no implementation-specific choreography to callers.
evidence_required: An unchanged adequate-artifact control plus a near-miss with no live proposal; score retained behavior and avoided obligations, not algebra vocabulary.
Preserve the pre-existing trigger, comparison, and authority rules.
